items.label: FIGURE 3.12
items.title: Positive relationship between income levels and GHG emissions

panel_a.title: Emissions per capita are converging between high- and upper-middle-income economies
panel_a.trends: High-income countries show a gradual decline from approx. 15 t CO2e in 2000 to approx. 12 t CO2e in 2022. Upper-middle-income countries show a gradual increase from approx. 5 t CO2e in 2000 to approx. 8 t CO2e in 2022. Low-income and lower-middle-income countries remain relatively flat and low, below 4 t CO2e.

panel_b.title: Ten economies produce two-thirds of global GHG emissions
